_docs.purpose: Instance-owned tier policy the dispatch gate consumes. Written during onboarding after the owner consents to an agent-inventory probe (or after they name entries by hand). Template ships only this example; never commit a filled copy.
_docs.version: Must be 2 for tier × fan-out caps. Version 1 identity allow/deny is legacy.
_docs.agents: Inventory of measured agent CLIs. Each entry records runtime name, version when measurable, and model_ids the CLI actually advertised. Never guess a model id — use the string unknown when a field cannot be measured. The gate does not require this array; it is for humans and for rebuilding tiers after re-measure.
_docs.tiers: Map of tier name to model id list. Put only measured (or owner-named) model ids here. Unlisted models fall into the reserved unknown tier and use fanout_caps.unknown.
_docs.fanout_caps: Per-tier cap on agents dispatched inside window_seconds. unknown must always be present so unlisted models stay conservatively capped.
_docs.window_seconds: Rolling window for the fan-out cap (seconds). Default 86400 (one day).
_docs.consent: Record whether the owner allowed the inventory probe: yes, no, or manual-only. Does not affect gate parsing.
